about_pullquote: I started because I hated waiting hours for a plumber. We don't do that.
about_para_1: Steve Sunderland Plumbing has been serving Sunderland homes and businesses for 18 years. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local name, built on showing up on time and fixing problems properly the first time. Every job carries a full guarantee, and we're proud to have completed over 2,000 installations and repairs across the city.
about_para_2: We're still the same outfit — no fancy call centres, no markups, just honest plumbers who answer your call and get on with the work. Families and business owners come back to us because we treat every leak and every installation with the same care, and we won't charge you for a callout if we can't help.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Pipe burst on a Sunday morning — thought I was in for a nightmare. Steve came out within 45 minutes, fixed it properly and didn't overcharge. That's rare these days. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: New boiler installation. The lads were tidy, professional, and explained everything as they went. Came in on budget and the system's running beautifully. Really happy.
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: Called at 11pm on a Saturday with a leaking radiator. Steve picked up, said he'd be round in an hour, and he was. Fixed in 20 minutes. This is how a local business should work.
reviews.author: Robert G.
